 Rockstar maintains one of the most recognizable traditions of the saga, although it introduces important changes in the activities available for Jason and Lucia

 GTA 6 continues to be a topic of conversation among video game fans due to the amount of details hidden in its open world. One of the locations that is sparking players' curiosity is the one known as "the heel," a name that refers to the strip clubs that have been part of the Grand Theft Auto franchise for more than two decades. 
 Advertising posters for the game Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6). Source: Eduardo Parra / Europa Press - Eduardo Parra / Europa Press The new installment from Rockstar Games brings back this feature in Vice City , but it doesn't just repeat what was seen in previous titles. GTA 6 incorporates three different establishments, with their own locations and interaction possibilities. A tradition that began more than 20 years ago and returns with important new features .
 What is the GTA 6 heel and where are the three clubs?
 The term "heel" is used among players to identify Grand Theft Auto strip clubs . Its name comes from the high-heeled shoe icon that appears on the map to indicate these establishments. In GTA 6, Rockstar has included three different venues spread across the map. The first is the Club NINE1NINE, located in Downtown, south of Crosstown, in Vice City . It is one of the establishments available from the early stages of the story and would be inspired by the well-known E11EVEN club in Miami. 
 Lucia’s hair physics are unreal. 🔥 pic.twitter.com/kBixlehKuH 
— GTA 6 (@GTA_VI_6_) November 11, 2026 The second is Jack of Hearts, located in Crosstown. Unlike the previous one, to access it, it will be necessary to advance at certain moments in the main story. Its design would be inspired by King of Diamonds , another well-known establishment in Miami. Finally, players will be able to visit Delights Cabaret, located in Port Gellhorn and which takes Bambi's Dollhouse in Panama City as a reference. 
 To recreate these scenarios, Rockstar would have visited real clubs and studied their operation, with the aim of transferring a much more detailed and realistic atmosphere to the video game. 
 What can you do in GTA 6 strip clubs?
 One of the main novelties of GTA 6 compared to previous installments is in the activities that these establishments allow. Although the clubs maintain part of their essence, Rockstar has eliminated some of the options that were present in previous video games. 
 On this occasion, players will be able to hire private dances, tip, and interact with the dancers . There will even be moments when they can dance on the floor. In addition, these venues can be visited with both Jason and Lucia, individually or accompanied by the other protagonist. However, it will no longer be possible to hire prostitutes or have the intimate encounters that appeared in previous installments . A decision that also relates to the importance Rockstar wants to give to the relationship between Jason and Lucia, whose development will depend on the decisions players make.
 Clubs will also not be merely secondary spaces to visit during games, as some will have a presence in the main story missions. The tradition of the heel began in 2002 with GTA Vice City , which incorporated the Pole Position Club . Subsequently, GTA San Andreas expanded these possibilities and GTA IV introduced establishments such as Triangle Club and Honkers . In GTA V, the Vanilla Unicorn became one of the most recognizable venues, especially due to its relationship with Trevor.
 More than two decades later, GTA 6 brings back this characteristic location of the franchise , but with new scenarios, more details, and changes in the available activities.
